text:
Mando and Grogu Fight a GIANT Ice Spider! | Star Wars Side-by-Side
See how one of The Mandalorian’s most chilling scenes came together - from early rough footage to the terrifying final product! After crash landing the Razor Crest on the icy planet of Maldo Kreis, Din Djarin, Grogu, and the Frog Lady find themselves hunted by giant ice spiders in one of the series’ tensest sequences.
